process_area.title: Loan Servicing, Referral Economics, Compliance & Analytics

value_stream.name: Home Construction Finance, Loan Brokerage & Mortgage Referral Services

fields.Trigger: Loan active (W4568); payment cycle; servicing query
fields.Volume: Servicing coordination across active loans (lender services; BuildRight supports)

workflows.name: Loan Servicing Coordination, Payment & Customer Support

Automation Opportunity: - Query-routing/support app; draw-billing status visibility; lender-servicing integration
Controls: - CTL-694 (ensure controlled execution — Loan Servicing, Referral Economics, Compliance & Analytics (PA-154.3).)
- CTL-694: lender services the loan (boundary clear); BuildRight coordinates queries (VS-13); draw-billing reconciled (VS-18)
Cross-references: - links to VS-13 (support), VS-18 (treasury), W4567 (draws), W4568 (activation), W4560 (integration)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Support-boundary risk**: BuildRight incorrectly assumes servicing liability; mitigated by clear boundary (lender services)
- **Confused-customer risk**: Customer unsure whom to pay/contact; mitigated by clear handoff & support routing
System Touchpoints: - Customer support (VS-13); treasury (VS-18); draw (W4567); lender servicing integration (W4560)
Time Estimate: - Per query minutes; per cycle ongoing

steps.activity: Lenders service the loan (amortization, collections, statements, payoff) — the lender's role; BuildRight does not service, only coordinates customer queries
Finance Desk/Customer Support handle BuildRight-side queries (payment channel, statement, draw status W4567), routing lender-specific items to the lender (VS-13)
Treasury/Finance Desk coordinate payment/draw timing where BuildRight billing interacts with loan draws (W4567/W4568), ensuring clean settlement

Automation Opportunity: - Commission calculation/reconciliation; revenue booking; incentive-pay automation (VS-102)
Controls: - CTL-694 (ensure controlled execution — Loan Servicing, Referral Economics, Compliance & Analytics (PA-154.3).)
- CTL-694: commission reconciled to lender (W4555); revenue tax-treated (VS-79); incentives tied to compliant/suitable referrals (W4557)
Cross-references: - links to VS-17/VS-79/VS-18 (finance/tax/treasury), VS-72 (intercompany), VS-102 (comp), W4555 (contracts), W4557 (suitability), W4573 (compliance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Commission-dispute risk**: Lender/BuildRight commission mismatch; mitigated by reconciliation & contract clarity (W4555)
- **Mis-selling-for-incentive risk**: Frontline pushes unsuitable loans for incentive; mitigated by suitability control (W4557) & incentive design
System Touchpoints: - Finance/GL (VS-17); tax (VS-79); treasury (VS-18); intercompany (VS-72); comp (VS-102); sales (VS-140)

steps.activity: Finance/Commercial calculate referral commission per lender agreements (W4555) on closed/drawn loans, and reconcile to lender statements
Finance/Tax book referral revenue (commission income, VAT/withholding per VS-79), and manage intercompany if applicable (VS-72)
HR/Commercial pay frontline incentives (finance-desk/trade referral incentive per VS-102), aligned to compliant referrals (W4573), and report revenue to the board (VS-36)

fields.Volume: Milestone/variation reconciliation across active financed projects

Automation Opportunity: - Milestone-confirmation evidence app; variation→draw change workflow; cost-vs-draw reconciliation
Controls: - CTL-694: milestones evidence-confirmed (VS-66/VS-12); variations change-controlled to draw; cost-vs-funding reconciled (VS-17/VS-18)
Cross-references: - links to VS-66/VS-12 (project/install), VS-11 (trade), VS-18/VS-17 (treasury/finance), W4567 (draws), VS-21.2 (risk)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Draw-variation-mismatch risk**: Variation not reflected in draw → funding gap (VS-18); mitigated by variation→draw change-control
- **Milestone-dispute risk**: Lender disputes completion → draw delay; mitigated by evidence-based confirmation
System Touchpoints: - Project design (VS-66); install (VS-12); trade (VS-11); treasury/finance (VS-18/VS-17); draw (W4567); risk (VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Project Design/Installation confirm milestone completion (VS-66/VS-12) to trigger the next draw (W4567), with evidence (inspection, photos)

steps.a: Finance Desk Lead / Lender UW Manager
steps.activity: Finance Desk/Lenders manage project variations (scope/cost change → loan/draw adjustment), per VS-66 change-control & lender process
Treasury/Finance reconcile project cost (BuildRight billing) vs loan draw (funding) across the project lifecycle, flagging gaps (VS-17/VS-18)

fields.Volume: Delinquency/default cases (lender manages; BuildRight manages exposure)

Automation Opportunity: - Exposure-at-default monitoring; referral-default-correlation analytics; recovery-case management
Controls: - CTL-694 (ensure controlled execution — Loan Servicing, Referral Economics, Compliance & Analytics (PA-154.3).)
- CTL-694: BuildRight exposure monitored (materials/services paid before delivery W4568); fair recovery (VS-100.3); default feeds pre-qualification tuning (W4557)
Cross-references: - links to VS-21.2 (risk), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-16/VS-68 (AR/credit), VS-11 (trade), VS-18 (treasury), W4568 (funding gate), W4575 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unpaid-materials risk**: BuildRight delivered before draw → loss on default; mitigated by confirmed-funding gate (W4568) & exposure monitoring
- **Reputational risk**: Aggressive BuildRight collection on distressed borrower; mitigated by fair, coordinated recovery
System Touchpoints: - Risk/ERM (VS-21.2); legal (VS-100.3); AR/credit (VS-16/VS-68); trade (VS-11); treasury (VS-18); analytics (W4575)

steps.a: Lender / Head of Internal Audit & Risk / CFO
steps.activity: Lenders manage collection/foreclosure on default (the lender's loan); BuildRight/Risk assess BuildRight's exposure (delivered-but-unpaid materials/services if billing led draws)
Finance/Legal manage BuildRight's exposure (recover delivered materials/services, mechanics-lien/contractor rights VS-100.3, AR risk VS-16/VS-68), and coordinate with the lender

steps.a: Head of Internal Audit & Risk / CFO
steps.activity: Risk/Compliance capture default data, analyze BuildRight-referral default correlation (W4575), and tune pre-qualification/suitability (W4557/W4561) to reduce future exposure

workflows.name: Regulatory Compliance, Consumer Protection & BSP Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - Compliance/disclosure automation; complaint-pattern analytics; fair-lending monitoring
Controls: - CTL-694: brokerage BSP/consumer-protection-compliant (VS-22); anti-steering/predatory enforced (W4557); disclosure compliant; complaints managed (VS-13)
Cross-references: - links to VS-22 (compliance), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-79 (tax), VS-91 (privacy), VS-21 (audit), VS-13 (complaints), W4557 (anti-predatory)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Anti-steering-failure risk**: Steering to higher-commission/harmful loans → regulatory action; mitigated by anti-predatory/anti-steering standard (W4557)
- **Disclosure-lapse risk**: Inadequate disclosure → consumer-protection exposure; mitigated by disclosure framework
System Touchpoints: - Compliance (VS-22); legal (VS-100.3); tax (VS-79); privacy (VS-91); audit (VS-21); complaints (VS-13)

steps.activity: Compliance/Legal maintain the compliance framework for brokerage activity (BSP consumer-protection, disclosure, anti-predatory W4557, fair-lending, anti-steering), per VS-22/VS-100.3
Compliance/Finance manage any brokerage reporting (commission disclosure, lender reports, BSP where applicable), and tax (VS-79) on referral revenue
Compliance/Audit manage complaints/regulatory inquiries (VS-13/VS-21), enforce fair-lending, and report compliance status to the board (VS-36)

Controls: - CTL-694: lenders performance-scorecarded (VS-67); disputes managed per contract (W4555); coverage maintained
Cross-references: - links to VS-67 (scorecard), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-22 (compliance), VS-21.2 (risk), W4554 (network), W4555 (contracts), W4575 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Poor-lender-service risk**: Slow/unfair lender harms BuildRight customer experience; mitigated by performance mgmt & exit
- **Coverage-gap risk**: Network too thin in a region/segment; mitigated by coverage analytics (W4575)
System Touchpoints: - Vendor scorecard (VS-67); legal (VS-100.3); compliance (VS-22); risk (VS-21.2); analytics (W4575)
Time Estimate: Periodic lender-partner performance measurement (approval rate, turn-time, commission economics), on-dispute case management for commission/SLA/liability and conduct issues, and the annual partner review/renewal/exit cycle (W4554) — effort is event-driven at dispute and renewal volume, absorbed by Commercial, Finance Strategy, Legal, and Risk within routine governance.

steps.activity: Commercial/Finance Strategy measure lender performance (approval rate, turn-time, commission accuracy, customer satisfaction, default rate) via VS-67-style scorecard
Commercial/Legal manage disputes (commission, SLA, liability) and conduct issues, per W4555 agreements
Commercial/Risk review/renew/exit partners (W4554), adjust the network for coverage/competitiveness, and report portfolio health to the board (VS-36)

Automation Opportunity: - Basket-lift/conversion model; default-correlation analytics; portfolio-intelligence dashboards
Controls: - CTL-694 (ensure controlled execution — Loan Servicing, Referral Economics, Compliance & Analytics (PA-154.3).)
- CTL-694: performance measured vs baseline (W4553); default correlation tracked (W4572); insights board-reported (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (data), VS-44 (insights), VS-13 (CRM), VS-11 (trade), VS-17 (finance), W4553 (baseline), W4572 (default), W4574 (lenders)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Attribution-error risk**: Mis-attributing basket-lift to financing; mitigated by controlled comparison/baseline
- **Default-blindness risk**: Referral revenue chased without default-correlation; mitigated by default analytics (W4572)

steps.activity: Data/Insights measure program performance (conversion lift, basket-size lift, project completion rate, referral revenue, default correlation) vs baseline (W4553)
Data/Finance Strategy analyze customer/basket patterns (financed vs non-financed basket, trade vs B2C, regional), feeding commercial decisions
Finance Strategy/Data report portfolio intelligence to the board (VS-36), tune product/offer/partners (W4553/W4554), and inform strategy (VS-33)

workflows.name: Program Performance Review, Risk & Strategic Adjustment

Automation Opportunity: - Performance-vs-baseline dashboards; strategic-options modeling; risk-adjusted-return analytics
Controls: - CTL-694 (ensure controlled execution — Loan Servicing, Referral Economics, Compliance & Analytics (PA-154.3).)
- CTL-694: program reviewed vs success metrics (W4553); adjustments legal-validated (brokerage-only VS-100.3); board-reported (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-33 (strategy), VS-21.2 (risk), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-134 (OCM), W4553 (baseline/success), W4575 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sunk-cost bias**: Persisting with underperforming program; mitigated by success-metric review
- **Charter-creep risk**: Adjusting toward lending; mitigated by legal validation (W4553) on any structural change
System Touchpoints: - Strategy (VS-33); risk (VS-21.2); legal (VS-100.3); OCM (VS-134); board (VS-36); analytics (W4575)

steps.activity: CFO/CMO/Strategy review the program vs W4553 success metrics (basket-lift, referral revenue, conversion, risk-adjusted return), and the strategic rationale
CFO/Strategy/Legal evaluate strategic adjustments (expand/restructure products, change partners, tighten/loosen credit policy, exit) if performance/rationale changes
CFO/CMO execute the chosen path (adjust product/partner/credit-policy W4556/W4554/W4557), with OCM (VS-134), and report to the board (VS-36)
